name: MBOK DARMI MOUNTAIN!
desc:
🏔️Welcome to mbok darmi mountain, a mountain made for fun with friends, cobain now lestgooo!🔥
Walk through beautiful forest and waterfall scenery, cross rocky bridges as well as exciting hurdles and reach a lake filled with amazingly beautiful shoals and moths.🌄
Come play with your closest friends and feel the trouble lesgoooo.🏆

Are you ready to conquer the mountain mbok darmi?
Like and favorite to support updates!✨
